meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成可交互的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作带分支导航和演讲者备注的交互式幻灯片
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create interactive slides with branching and speaker notes

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会将内容组织成可导航的幻灯片：每张幻灯片有独立场景，支持逐步揭示内容、热点跳转到分支幻灯片，并包含演示者笔记。输出为浏览器中可翻页的交互式页面，而非渲染视频。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求制作幻灯片/演示文稿/交互式演示，或要求将现有页面转换为幻灯片时触发。若请求模糊（如“presentation”），Claude 会先询问确认。

say.text: 帮我做一个关于产品功能的幻灯片。
say.note: Claude 会生成可导航的幻灯片组。

say.text: 把这个网页转换成幻灯片，保留原有设计。
say.note: Claude 会复制视觉和交互，生成幻灯片。

say.text: 给第一张幻灯片添加热点，跳转到详情分支。
say.note: Claude 会在 JSON 岛中添加热点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude organizes content into a navigable slideshow: each slide has its own scene, supports fragment reveals, hotspot branching to off-line slide sequences, and presenter notes. The output is an interactive deck for the browser, not a rendered video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user explicitly asks for a slideshow, presentation, interactive deck, or to convert an existing page. If the request is ambiguous (e.g., 'presentation'), Claude will confirm before authoring.

say_en.text: Create a slideshow about product features.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a navigable deck.

say_en.text: Convert this webpage into a slideshow, keeping its design.
say_en.note: Claude will port visuals and interactions.

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on slide 1 branching to a detail branch.
say_en.note: Claude will add a hotspot in the JSON island.
